_comment: Repos hand-fed into the triage queue because no search can reach them.
The other three discovery sources all ask GitHub a question, so all three
are blind to a plugin whose author tagged nothing, published nothing to
npm, and used no conventional layout. Those exist and some of them are
large: yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite carried 6,415 stars and zero topics on
the day it was seeded here.
A seed grants nothing. It enters data/candidates.json at the back of the
queue like every other find and still has to prove an install path in
scripts/triage.mjs before it reaches the registry. Hearing about a repo is
`via` is categorical on purpose. A slug is a public fact; who mentioned it
in which room is not ours to publish. Say 'community chat' or 'forum',
never a group name or a person.
Once a seeded repo is decided it can stay in this file — the queue drops
anything already in a registry — so the list doubles as the record of what

seeds.note: Multi-root logical workspaces for DeepSeek Harness

Draft admission and implementation standard for dsh TUI plugins
Draft community interoperability standard for the dsh plugin ecosystem
Unofficial community hub for plugin submissions and contributor onboarding
Multimodal plugins for Qwen models, presented as harness-agnostic
Single-file dsh plugin-development skill, flat top-level <name>.md layout, zero topics
